classifications.rationale: The President presently makes the statutory determination supporting the export controls; the legal consequence occurs upon that determination, rather than through a later mandated agency decision.
classifications.evidence: I have determined pursuant to Section 4(c) of the Act that the absence of such controls would prove detrimental to the foreign policy and national security interests of the United States.

classifications.rationale: The segment inseparably combines a present statutory presidential determination with internal policy review and revision directions and a future report to Congress, which carry materially different legal postures.
classifications.evidence: Pursuant to Section 6(d) of the Act, I have determined that although reasonable efforts have been made to achieve the purposes of these controls through alternative means, available alternatives would not comparably advance the foreign policy and national security interests of the United States.

classifications.rationale: The President presently makes the national-security finding legally supporting the export curtailment; the consequence attaches to that finding, while the remainder principally reports impacts and completed or ongoing agency measures.
classifications.evidence: I find that the exports being curtailed by this action make a significant contribution to the military potential of the Soviet Union that is detrimental to the national security of the United States.
